name: Accel (India)
identity_check: Accel's India arm: the Bangalore-based investment team of Accel (accel.com), the global venture firm, which raises dedicated early-stage India funds (seventh, eighth and ninth India funds per Entrackr, Inc42 and Entrepreneur India) and runs the Atoms pre-seed programme (atoms.accel.com) for Indian and Indian-origin founders. Accel's own site uses no separate 'Accel India' brand: its team page tags nine people 'Based in: Bangalore, India' (one, Dinesh Katiyar, says in his bio he is based in the SF Bay Area). Rounds were kept only where the India arm is evident (an India-based company, a Bangalore partner's portfolio list or byline, or the Atoms / Atoms X programmes). Not Accel US or Accel Europe & Israel (separate records; their deals on accel.com, e.g. Atira in Munich, Arrakis, Forus Series B, are excluded), not Accel Leaders / the global growth fund, and not Accel-KKR.

open_items: Check size: no cheque range stated for the India funds. Atoms AI Cohort 2026: Accel and Google's AI Futures Fund co-invest 'up to $2 million' per startup combined (not Accel's own cheque). A YourStory headline (Oct 2025, page returned 403) says Accel and Prosus each invest $1M per startup under Atoms X; not read, not recorded.

No pitch channel for the main India funds on accel.com: the Contact page lists only Palo Alto and San Francisco addresses and a generic contact button. Application URL and cold inbound = 'yes' rest on the open Atoms application (atoms.accel.com, 'Apply' links to apply.accel-atoms.com), which is pre-seed only.

requires_us_entity = 'no': Atoms targets 'Indian & Indian-origin founders building from anywhere'; the India team leads rounds in Indian companies (Fabheads, Chennai; Oolka, Bengaluru) and also backs US-headquartered companies with India teams (Fibr AI, San Francisco HQ with 17 of ~23 staff in India, led by Accel with Prayank Swaroop quoted; Origin, San Francisco, Subrata Mitra byline; Ema, Mountain View, on Subrata Mitra's portfolio list). So it invests in US-domiciled companies with Indian founders. No page states incorporation (Delaware vs India) or a flip requirement.

Manufacturing / industrial focus: eighth fund (Jan 2025) named manufacturing among its sectors; ninth fund (Aug 2026) names advanced manufacturing and deeptech as emerging areas; Atoms sector dropdown includes 'Industry 5.0'; Atoms X (with Prosus) backs science-led/deeptech startups. Portfolio includes Zetwerk (IPO Oct 2026, Prayank Swaroop post), Fabheads, Scimplify, Moglix, Venwiz. No stated focus on AI for factory operations specifically.

Earlier India funds (first to sixth) not researched: names, sizes and dates not found. Inc42 says total India commitments exceed $3 Bn. Eighth fund (Jan 2025) covered India and Southeast Asia, raised from 131 LPs; Entrackr sources say over 50% of it was still undeployed in Aug 2026.

Ninth fund close date recorded as the announcement date (12 Aug 2026); Entrepreneur India says it closed 'within weeks' and was oversubscribed. Seventh fund dated to its March 2022 announcement (Inc42 says 2022).

Atoms is not recorded as a fund: no size found. Entrackr (Jan 2025) says Atoms, then in its fourth iteration, had supported 36 startups that collectively raised over $200M. Atoms AI Cohort 2026 (with Google) took applications to 26 Jan 2026; Atoms X (with Prosus) inaugural cohort is 'six startups' per Inc42 (QOSMIC article).
portfolio_count_reported not found for India; accel.com/companies shows 'Companies(782)' for the global firm with no region filter.

Accel-led rounds not recorded because the arm is not confirmed on a fetched page: Atlas ($6M seed co-led with Stellaris Venture Partners, Apr 2026, AI for accounting firms, Entrackr) and Bachatt ($12M Series A led by Accel with Lightspeed and Info Edge Ventures, Mar 2026, Entrackr). Both look India-team deals but no city or Bangalore partner was named.
Origin stage: Entrackr and Inc42 do not name a stage; Accel's post says the team reached US deployments 'before hitting their Series A'. Recorded as undisclosed.

Not fetched: Atoms AI Cohort 2026 company list (YourStory 403), Material Depot round (Accel post gives no round details; first backed via Atoms), Venwiz, Nurix AI, Bridgetown Research, Doctor Droid, Seezo rounds.

Partner titles: accel.com shows no titles; only Prayank Swaroop is called partner (Entrepreneur India). Prashanth Prakash (consumer) and Abhinav Chaturvedi / Mahendran Balachandran (consumer, fintech, SaaS, enterprise) are also on the Bangalore team but not listed as AI / industrial partners. Barath Shankar Subramanian's bio says he is active in Atoms for pre-seed startups in India and SEA.

Portfolio overlap to check: Scimplify (specialty chemicals manufacturing, Bengaluru) and Fabheads (composites) are manufacturing companies, potential customers; no AI-for-factory-operations competitor found in the India portfolio pages read.
